input.title: Checkout latency
input.markdown:
Checkout p99 latency rose to 523 ms at 10:05 UTC, up from 287 ms (+82%), a rise of 236 ms.

About 4.1% of requests failed (1,284 of 31.2K), and payment calls timed out after 2.4 s, with retries every 0.25 s.

Trace p99 was 812 ms and p50 143 ms over 4.5K traces, so the slow tail is 5.7x the median. 3 pods restarted.

See [the dashboard](/o/abc123) and `rate(http_requests_total[5m])`.
